## 🍒 Commits to Cherry-Pick (in order)

### 1. `16bf67f` — `.secrets.baseline` refresh + accountability report touch

```
fix(ci): universal baseline sweep — sync+auto_fix [skip ci]
```

**Files changed:**
- `.secrets.baseline` — `CODEX_MANIFEST.json` `hashed_secret` updated at line 2053
  (`c4b165e3…` → `55bfe3bd…`) after `integrity_sha256` changed in `CODEX_MANIFEST.json`
- `docs/accountability/AGENT_ACCOUNTABILITY_REPORT.md` — CI auto-entry appended

**Why needed:** Without this, `detect-secrets` baseline check fails because
`CODEX_MANIFEST.json` integrity hash changed but `.secrets.baseline` was stale.

**Cherry-pick command:**
